description:
List every channel Luca supports and whether it can be connected yet. Availability is per channel, not per coach.

Luca operation: GET /api/channels/catalog
Required scopes: channels:read
Required OAuth scope: luca:read; data sensitivity: redacted
Does not require idempotency.
Use workspaceId or workspaceSlug to override the default workspace configured by environment.
name: luca_channels_catalog
title: List available channels
